```{r setup}
run_or_load <- function(name, expr_fun, force = FALSE) {
  path <- file.path(checkpoint_dir, paste0(name, ".rds"))
  if (!force && file.exists(path)) {
    cat(sprintf("[checkpoint] '%s' <- loaded from cache\n", name)); flush.console()
    return(readRDS(path))
  }
  cat(sprintf("[checkpoint] '%s' <- computing (no cache found, or force=TRUE)...\n", name)); flush.console()
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  result <- expr_fun()
  elapsed <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))
  cat(sprintf("[checkpoint] '%s' done in %.1f sec -- cached to %s\n", name, elapsed, path)); flush.console()
  saveRDS(result, path)
  result
}
```

```{r prep_val}
merge_bac_fun <- function(ps_bac, ps_fun, cohort_name = "") {
  sample_data(ps_bac)$..tmp_fix.. <- 1
  sample_data(ps_fun)$..tmp_fix.. <- 1
  ps_merged <- phyloseq::merge_phyloseq(ps_bac, ps_fun)
  sample_data(ps_merged)$..tmp_fix.. <- NULL
  return(ps_merged)
}
```

```{r dis_data}
prep_data <- function() {

# filter low pervalence
filter_prevalence <- function(phylo, min_prevalence = 0.10, kingdom = "bac") {
  otu <- as(otu_table(phylo), "matrix")
  if (!taxa_are_rows(phylo)) otu <- t(otu)
  prevalence <- rowMeans(otu > 0)
  keep <- prevalence >= min_prevalence
  cat(sprintf("[%s] Prevalence filter (>=%.0f%%): keeping %d / %d taxa\n",
              kingdom, min_prevalence * 100, sum(keep), length(keep)))
  prune_taxa(names(prevalence)[keep], phylo)
}

filtered <- run_or_load("data_filtered_10pct", function() {
  ps_bac_f    <- filter_prevalence(ps_bac, 0.10, "bac")
  ps_fun_f    <- filter_prevalence(ps_fun, 0.10, "fun")
  ps_bacfun_f <- merge_phyloseq(ps_bac_f, ps_fun_f)
  list(ps_bac = ps_bac_f, ps_fun = ps_fun_f, ps_bacfun = ps_bacfun_f)
})

ps_bac    <- filtered$ps_bac
ps_fun    <- filtered$ps_fun

# batch correction
batch_correct <- function(phylo, kingdom = "bac") {
  cat(sprintf("[%s] MMUPHin input: %d taxa x %d samples\n", kingdom, ntaxa(phylo), nsamples(phylo)))
  phylo_rel <- microbiome::transform(phylo, "compositional")
  otu_rel <- as.matrix(otu_table(phylo_rel))
  mdata_local <- mdata[colnames(otu_rel), , drop = FALSE]
  sample_data(phylo_rel) <- sample_data(mdata_local)
  mmuphin_res <- adjust_batch(feature_abd = otu_rel, batch = "Batch", covariates = "Group", data = mdata_local)
  cat(sprintf("[%s] Features into MMUPHin: %d | out: %d\n",
              kingdom, nrow(otu_rel), nrow(mmuphin_res$feature_abd_adj)))

  phylo_mmuphin <- prune_taxa(rownames(mmuphin_res$feature_abd_adj), phylo_rel)
  otu_table(phylo_mmuphin) <- otu_table(mmuphin_res$feature_abd_adj, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
  phylo_mmuphin
}

ps_bac_mmuphin    <- run_or_load("ps_bac_mmuphin_10pct",    function() batch_correct(ps_bac, "bac"))
ps_fun_mmuphin    <- run_or_load("ps_fun_mmuphin_10pct",    function() batch_correct(ps_fun, "fun"))
ps_bacfun_mmuphin <- run_or_load("ps_bacfun_mmuphin_10pct", function() batch_correct(ps_bacfun, "bacfun"))

# taxonomy dictionary
build_taxonomy_lookup <- function(ps) {
  tax_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps))
  tax_df$Feature <- rownames(tax_df)
  rownames(tax_df) <- NULL
  tax_df %>% dplyr::select(Feature, dplyr::everything())
}

taxonomy_lookup <- list(
  bac    = build_taxonomy_lookup(ps_bac_mmuphin),
  fun    = build_taxonomy_lookup(ps_fun_mmuphin),
  bacfun = build_taxonomy_lookup(ps_bacfun_mmuphin)
)

annotate_with_taxonomy <- function(df) {
  if (!"Dataset" %in% colnames(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(df)
  do.call(rbind, lapply(unique(df$Dataset), function(k) {
    sub <- df[df$Dataset == k, , drop = FALSE]
    lookup <- taxonomy_lookup[[as.character(k)]]
    if (is.null(lookup)) return(sub)
    dplyr::left_join(sub, lookup, by = "Feature")
  }))
}
```

# 3. Prep Validation
```{r validation_helpers}
align_and_transform <- function(ps_valid, ps_discovery, transform_method,
                                kingdom="bac", cohort_name="China_Cohort", match_rank="Species") {
  disc_tax <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_discovery))
  val_tax <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_valid))

  disc_map <- data.frame(discovery_taxon = rownames(disc_tax),
                         species = as.character(disc_tax[[match_rank]]), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    filter(!is.na(species) & species != "") %>%
    distinct(species, .keep_all = TRUE)

  val_map <- data.frame(validation_taxon = rownames(val_tax),
                        species = as.character(val_tax[[match_rank]]), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    filter(!is.na(species) & species != "") %>%
    distinct(species, .keep_all = TRUE)

  discovery_taxa <- taxa_names(ps_discovery)

  map_df <- data.frame(discovery_taxon = discovery_taxa, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(disc_map, by = "discovery_taxon") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(val_map, by = "species")

  has_match <- !is.na(map_df$validation_taxon)

  cat(sprintf("[%s/%s] %d / %d discovery taxa matched (%.1f%%)\n", kingdom, cohort_name,
              sum(has_match), length(discovery_taxa), 100 * sum(has_match) / length(discovery_taxa)))

  ps_valid_t <- microbiome::transform(ps_valid, transform_method)
  val_t <- as(otu_table(ps_valid_t), "matrix")
  if (!taxa_are_rows(ps_valid_t)) val_t <- t(val_t)

  padded <- matrix(0, nrow=length(discovery_taxa), ncol = ncol(val_t),
                   dimnames = list(discovery_taxa, colnames(val_t)))
  padded[map_df$discovery_taxon[has_match], ] <- val_t[map_df$validation_taxon[has_match], , drop=FALSE]

  list(X=as.data.frame(t(padded)), match_rate=sum(has_match)/length(discovery_taxa))
}

build_validation_list <- function(kingdom, ps_discovery, transform_method) {
  objs <- switch(kingdom,
    bac    = list(China_Cohort=ps_China_bac,    Thai_Cohort=ps_Thai_bac,    Korea_Cohort=ps_Korea_bac),
    fun    = list(China_Cohort=ps_China_fun,    Thai_Cohort=ps_Thai_fun,    Korea_Cohort=ps_Korea_fun),
    bacfun = list(China_Cohort=ps_China_bacfun, Thai_Cohort=ps_Thai_bacfun, Korea_Cohort=ps_Korea_bacfun)
    )

  out <- list()
  for (nm in names(objs)) {
    aligned <- align_and_transform(objs[[nm]], ps_discovery, transform_method, kingdom, nm)
    meta <- as(sample_data(objs[[nm]]), "data.frame")
    y <- factor(meta[rownames(aligned$X), "Group"], levels = c("HCC", "CO"))
    out[[nm]] <- list(X = aligned$X, y = y, match_rate = aligned$match_rate)
  }
  out
}
```

# 4. Feature selection: Adaboost
```{r}
select_adaboost <- function(trainX, trainY, seed = 1, nIter = 50) {
  set.seed(seed)
  all_features <- colnames(trainX)

  ctrl <- trainControl(method = "none")
  tune_grid <- data.frame(mfinal = nIter, maxdepth = 1, coeflearn = "Breiman")
  fit <- train(x = trainX, y = trainY, method = "AdaBoost.M1", trControl = ctrl, tuneGrid = tune_grid)

  ada_model <- fit$finalModel
  imp <- ada_model$importance

  if (is.null(imp) || length(imp) == 0) {
    stop("select_adaboost(): unable to extract 'importance' from adabag model -- ")
  }
  if (!all(names(imp) %in% all_features)) {
    stop("select_adaboost(): adabag importance names do not match trainX column names -- ",
         "likely make.names() sanitizing non-syntactic feature names inside caret's formula ",
         "interface. Mismatched names: ",
         paste(setdiff(names(imp), all_features), collapse = ", "))
  }

  imp_acc <- setNames(numeric(length(all_features)), all_features)
  imp_acc[names(imp)] <- imp

  data.frame(Feature = names(imp_acc), Importance = as.numeric(imp_acc), row.names = NULL) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(Importance))
}
```

# 5. Training function
```{r training_function}
run_training <- function(ps, kingdom="bac", group_var="Group", group_levels=c("HCC", "CO"), positive_class="HCC",
                         n_features = 20, n_repeats = 20,
                         cv_folds = 5, cv_repeats = 20,
                         validation_list = list()
                         ) {

  cat(sprintf("[%s / Adaboost] ntaxa: %d | N_Features = %d | repeats = %d\n",
              kingdom, ntaxa(ps), n_features, n_repeats))

  mdata_ps <- as(sample_data(ps), "data.frame")
  otu <- if (taxa_are_rows(ps)) as.data.frame(t(as(otu_table(ps), "matrix")))
  else as.data.frame(as(otu_table(ps), "matrix"))

  df1 <- merge(otu, mdata_ps[, group_var, drop = FALSE], by = "row.names") %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("Row.names")

  colnames(df1)[colnames(df1) == group_var] <- "Group"
  df1$Group <- factor(df1$Group, levels = group_levels)
  X <- df1 %>% dplyr::select(-Group)
  y <- df1$Group

  other_class <- setdiff(group_levels, positive_class)
  resultsList <- list()
  featureList <- list()
  predList    <- list()

  for (i in seq_len(n_repeats)) {
    message("[", kingdom, "/Adaboost] Repeat ", i, " / ", n_repeats)
    flush.console()

    set.seed(i + 100)
    inTrain <- createDataPartition(y, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
    trainX <- X[inTrain, , drop = FALSE]; trainY <- y[inTrain]
    testX  <- X[-inTrain, , drop = FALSE]; testY  <- y[-inTrain]

    set.seed(20 + i)
    train_down <- downSample(x = trainX, y = trainY, list = FALSE, yname = "Group")
    trainX_bal <- train_down %>% dplyr::select(-Group)
    trainY_bal <- train_down$Group

    nzv_bal_idx <- nearZeroVar(trainX_bal)
    if (length(nzv_bal_idx) > 0) {
      message(" [check] ", length(nzv_bal_idx),
              " feature(s) became near-zero-variance after downsampling--removing")
      trainX_bal <- trainX_bal[, -nzv_bal_idx, drop = FALSE]
    }

    imp_df <- select_adaboost(trainX_bal, trainY_bal, seed = 30 + i)

    max_avail <- nrow(imp_df)
    nf_use <- min(n_features, max_avail)
    if (nf_use < n_features)
      message(" Requested n_features=", n_features, " but only ", max_avail, " available; using ", nf_use)

    selected_features <- imp_df$Feature[seq_len(nf_use)]

    featureList[[i]] <- data.frame(
      Dataset = kingdom, FeatureMethod = "Adaboost", N_Features = nf_use,
      Repeat = i, Feature = selected_features,
      Importance = imp_df$Importance[seq_len(nf_use)]
    )

    set.seed(1000 + i * 100 + n_features)
    ctrl <- trainControl(method = "repeatedcv", number = cv_folds, repeats = cv_repeats, classProbs = TRUE,
                          summaryFunction = twoClassSummary, savePredictions = "final")

    final_model <- train(x = trainX_bal[, selected_features, drop = FALSE], y = trainY_bal,
                         method = "rf", trControl = ctrl, metric = "ROC",
                         tuneLength = 5, preProcess = c("center", "scale"))

    testX_sel <- testX[, selected_features, drop = FALSE]
    probs <- predict(final_model, newdata=testX_sel, type="prob")[, positive_class]
    preds <- predict(final_model, newdata=testX_sel)
    cmatrix <- confusionMatrix(preds, testY, positive = positive_class)
    roc_val <- roc(testY, probs, quiet=TRUE, levels=rev(group_levels), direction="<")

    tbl <- cmatrix$table
    TP <- tbl[positive_class, positive_class]; FP <- tbl[positive_class, other_class]
    FN <- tbl[other_class, positive_class];    TN <- tbl[other_class, other_class]

    resultsList[[length(resultsList) +1]] <- data.frame(Dataset=kingdom,
                                                        FeatureMethod="Adaboost",
                                                        Repeat=i,
                                                        N_Features=nf_use,
                                                        Split="Hold-out test set",
                                                        AUC=as.numeric(roc_val$auc),
                                                        Acc=cmatrix$overall[["Accuracy"]],
                                                        Sens=cmatrix$byClass[["Sensitivity"]],
                                                        Spec=cmatrix$byClass[["Specificity"]],
                                                        F1=cmatrix$byClass[["F1"]]
                                                        )

    predList[[length(predList) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      Dataset = kingdom, FeatureMethod = "Adaboost", Repeat = i, N_Features = nf_use,
      Split = "Hold-out test set", SampleID = rownames(testX_sel),
      obs = as.character(testY), prob = as.numeric(probs), row.names = NULL
    )

    for (val_name in names(validation_list)) {
      val_data <- validation_list[[val_name]]
      missing_cols <- setdiff(selected_features, colnames(val_data$X))
      if(length(missing_cols) >0) {
        warning(sprintf("[%s/%s] %d selected feature(s) unexpectedly missing--filling with 0...",
                        kingdom, val_name, length(missing_cols)))
        for (mc in missing_cols) val_data$X[[mc]] <- 0
      }

      val_X_sel <- val_data$X[, selected_features, drop=FALSE]
      val_probs <- predict(final_model, newdata=val_X_sel, type="prob")[, positive_class]
      val_preds <- predict(final_model, newdata=val_X_sel)
      val_cm <- confusionMatrix(val_preds, val_data$y, positive=positive_class)
      val_roc <- roc(val_data$y, val_probs, quiet=TRUE, levels=rev(group_levels), direction="<")
      val_tbl <- val_cm$table
      vTP <- val_tbl[positive_class, positive_class]; vFP <- val_tbl[positive_class, other_class]
      vFN <- val_tbl[other_class, positive_class];    vTN <- val_tbl[other_class, other_class]

      resultsList[[length(resultsList) +1]] <- data.frame(Dataset=kingdom,
                                                          FeatureMethod="Adaboost",
                                                          Repeat=i,
                                                          N_Features=nf_use,
                                                          Split=val_name,
                                                          AUC=as.numeric(val_roc$auc),
                                                          Acc=val_cm$overall[["Accuracy"]],
                                                          Sens=val_cm$byClass[["Sensitivity"]],
                                                          Spec=val_cm$byClass[["Specificity"]],
                                                          F1=val_cm$byClass[["F1"]]
                                                          )

      predList[[length(predList) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        Dataset = kingdom, FeatureMethod = "Adaboost", Repeat = i, N_Features = nf_use,
        Split = val_name, SampleID = rownames(val_X_sel),
        obs = as.character(val_data$y), prob = as.numeric(val_probs), row.names = NULL
      )
      }
  }

  list(kingdom=kingdom, feature_selection="Adaboost",
       results=do.call(rbind, resultsList),
       features=do.call(rbind, featureList),
       predictions=do.call(rbind, predList)
       )
}
```

# 6. Running
```{r running}
kingdoms <- list(bac=ps_bac_mmuphin, fun=ps_fun_mmuphin, bacfun=ps_bacfun_mmuphin)

all_final_results      <- list()
all_feature_records    <- list()
all_prediction_records <- list()
validation_lists       <- list()
failed_combos <- character(0)

for (kname in names(kingdoms)) {
  ps <- kingdoms[[kname]]

  val_list <- tryCatch(build_validation_list(kname, ps, "compositional"),
                       error=function(e) {
                         message(sprintf("[FAILED] build_validation_list for kingdom '%s' -- %s.
                                         Skipping this kingdom.", kname, conditionMessage(e)))
                         failed_combos <<- c(failed_combos, sprintf("%s/ALL (validation_list build failed)",
                                                                    kname))
                         NULL
                         }
                       )
  if (is.null(val_list)) next
  validation_lists[[kname]] <- val_list

  ckpt_name <- sprintf("%s_mmuphin_adaboost_n20_final", kname)

  res <- tryCatch(run_or_load(ckpt_name, function() {
    run_training(ps, kingdom = kname, n_features = 20, n_repeats = 20, validation_list = val_list)
  }),
  error = function(e) {message(sprintf("[FAILED] %s/adaboost/N20 -- %s.", kname, conditionMessage(e)))
    failed_combos <<- c(failed_combos, sprintf("%s/adaboost/N20", kname))
    NULL
    }
  )
  if (is.null(res)) next

  all_final_results[[kname]]      <- res$results
  all_feature_records[[kname]]    <- res$features
  all_prediction_records[[kname]] <- res$predictions
}

if (length(failed_combos) > 0) {
  cat("\n== WARNING: the following combinations failed and were skipped ==\n")
  cat(paste(" -", failed_combos), sep = "\n")
} else {
  cat("\nAll completed successfully.\n")
}

all_results <- do.call(rbind, all_final_results)
all_results$Split <- factor(all_results$Split, 
                            levels = c("Hold-out test set", "China_Cohort", "Thai_Cohort", "Korea_Cohort"))

all_results$Dataset <- factor(all_results$Dataset, levels = c("bac", "fun", "bacfun"))

all_features <- do.call(rbind, all_feature_records)
n_repeats_used <- max(all_features$Repeat)
cat(sprintf("n_repeats detected from the data: %d\n", n_repeats_used))

write.csv(all_results, file.path(perf_dir, "full_results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

all_predictions <- do.call(rbind, all_prediction_records)
all_predictions$Split <- factor(all_predictions$Split,
                                levels = c("Hold-out test set", "China_Cohort", "Thai_Cohort", "Korea_Cohort"))
all_predictions$Dataset <- factor(all_predictions$Dataset, levels = c("bac", "fun", "bacfun"))
all_predictions$obs <- factor(all_predictions$obs, levels = c("HCC", "CO"))
write.csv(all_predictions, file.path(perf_dir, "raw_predictions_for_roc.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

# 7. Performance summary (AUC, Acc, Sens, Spec, F1 -- no MCC)
```{r combined_results}
summary_final <- all_results %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Dataset, Split) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_repeats=dplyr::n(),
                   mean_AUC = mean(AUC), sd_AUC = sd(AUC), se_AUC = sd(AUC) / sqrt(dplyr::n()),
                   mean_Acc = mean(Acc), sd_Acc = sd(Acc), se_Acc = sd(Acc) / sqrt(dplyr::n()),
                   mean_Sens = mean(Sens), sd_Sens = sd(Sens), se_Sens = sd(Sens) / sqrt(dplyr::n()),
                   mean_Spec = mean(Spec), sd_Spec = sd(Spec), se_Spec = sd(Spec) / sqrt(dplyr::n()),
                   mean_F1 = mean(F1), sd_F1 = sd(F1), se_F1 = sd(F1) / sqrt(dplyr::n()),
                   .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(ci95_AUC_lo = mean_AUC - qt(0.975, df = n_repeats - 1) * se_AUC,
                ci95_AUC_hi = mean_AUC + qt(0.975, df = n_repeats - 1) * se_AUC)

cat("\n=== Summary: mean AUC / Acc / Sens / Spec / F1 (t-based 95% CI) ===\n")
print(as.data.frame(summary_final))
write.csv(summary_final, file.path(perf_dir, "summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

SPLIT_COLOR <- c("Hold-out test set" = "#0072B2", "China Cohort" = "#D55E00",
                 "Korea Cohort" = "#009E73", "Thai Cohort" = "#CC79A7")
```

# 9. ROC curves
```{r roc_curves}
# Compute mean ROC for each pair-dataset
compute_mean_roc <- function(df, group_cols = c("Dataset", "Split"), fpr_grid = seq(0, 1, by = 0.01)) {
  groups <- df %>% dplyr::distinct(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(group_cols)))
  out <- vector("list", nrow(groups))

  for (g in seq_len(nrow(groups))) {
    sub <- dplyr::inner_join(df, groups[g, , drop = FALSE], by = group_cols)
    repeats <- sort(unique(sub$Repeat))
    tpr_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(repeats), ncol = length(fpr_grid))
    auc_vec <- rep(NA_real_, length(repeats))

    for (i in seq_along(repeats)) {
      sr <- sub %>% dplyr::filter(Repeat == repeats[i])
      if (length(unique(sr$obs)) < 2 || nrow(sr) < 3) next

      roc_r <- tryCatch(pROC::roc(sr$obs, sr$prob, quiet = TRUE, levels = rev(c("HCC", "CO")), direction = "<"),
                        error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(roc_r)) next

      auc_vec[i] <- as.numeric(roc_r$auc)
      fpr_r <- 1 - roc_r$specificities
      tpr_r <- roc_r$sensitivities
      ord <- order(fpr_r)
      tpr_mat[i, ] <- approx(fpr_r[ord], tpr_r[ord], xout = fpr_grid, ties = mean)$y
    }

    mean_tpr <- colMeans(tpr_mat, na.rm = TRUE)
    se_tpr   <- apply(tpr_mat, 2, function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(x))))

    out[[g]] <- data.frame(groups[g, , drop = FALSE], FPR = fpr_grid, mean_TPR = mean_tpr, se_TPR = se_tpr,
                           mean_AUC = mean(auc_vec, na.rm = TRUE), n_repeats_total = sum(!is.na(auc_vec)))
  }
  do.call(rbind, out)
}
```

# 11. Final model refit (consensus top-20 features, full discovery data)
- this model was used to compute SHAP explanation 
- fit the discovery data using top-20 importance features (frequency & mean importance)
- explain on validation datasets

```{r refit_final_model}
get_discovery_XY <- function(ps, group_var = "Group", group_levels = c("HCC", "CO")) {
  mdata_ps <- as(sample_data(ps), "data.frame")
  otu <- if (taxa_are_rows(ps)) as.data.frame(t(as(otu_table(ps), "matrix")))
  else as.data.frame(as(otu_table(ps), "matrix"))
  df1 <- merge(otu, mdata_ps[, group_var, drop = FALSE], by = "row.names") %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("Row.names")
  colnames(df1)[colnames(df1) == group_var] <- "Group"
  df1$Group <- factor(df1$Group, levels = group_levels)
  list(X = df1 %>% dplyr::select(-Group), y = df1$Group)
}

get_consensus_features <- function(feature_freq, kingdom, n = 20) {
  feature_freq %>%
    dplyr::filter(Dataset == kingdom) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(frequency), dplyr::desc(mean_importance)) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = n) %>%
    dplyr::pull(Feature)
}

refit_final_model <- function(kingdom, ps, consensus_features, seed = 2026) {
  
  xy <- get_discovery_XY(ps)
  
  set.seed(seed)
  down <- downSample(x = xy$X, y = xy$y, list = FALSE, yname = "Group")
  trainX_bal <- down %>% dplyr::select(-Group)
  trainY_bal <- down$Group
  
  trainX_sel <- trainX_bal[, consensus_features, drop = FALSE]

  ctrl <- trainControl(method = "repeatedcv", number = 5, repeats = 20, classProbs = TRUE,
                       summaryFunction = twoClassSummary, savePredictions = "final")
 
  set.seed(seed)
  model <- train(x = trainX_sel, y = trainY_bal, method = "rf", trControl = ctrl,
                metric = "ROC", tuneLength = 5, preProcess = c("center", "scale"))
  
  list(model = model, trainX_sel = trainX_sel, trainY_bal = trainY_bal)
}

consensus_features_list <- setNames(
  lapply(names(kingdoms), function(k) get_consensus_features(feature_freq, k)),
  names(kingdoms)
)

pred_wrapper <- function(object, newdata) predict(object, newdata = newdata, type = "prob")[, "HCC"]

refit_models <- list()
for (kname in names(kingdoms)) {
  ckpt_name <- sprintf("%s_refit_final_n20", kname)
  refit_models[[kname]] <- run_or_load(ckpt_name, function() {
    refit_final_model(kname, kingdoms[[kname]], consensus_features_list[[kname]])
  })
}
```

# 12. SHAP explanation
```{r shap_compute}
SHAP_NSIM <- 500   # Monte Carlo permutations per fastshap::explain() call; higher = less noisy, slower

build_species_labels <- function(kingdom, features) {
  taxonomy_lookup[[kingdom]] %>%
    dplyr::filter(Feature %in% features) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(Feature, Species) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Species_clean = gsub("^[a-z]__", "", Species),
                  Dataset = kingdom) %>%
    dplyr::select(Dataset, Feature, Species_clean)
}

compute_shap_for_kingdom <- function(kingdom, refit, val_list, seed = 2026) {
  model <- refit$model
  trainX_sel <- refit$trainX_sel
  baseline <- mean(pred_wrapper(model, trainX_sel))

  out <- list()
  for (cohort in names(val_list)) {
    val_X_sel <- val_list[[cohort]]$X[, colnames(trainX_sel), drop = FALSE]

    set.seed(seed)
    shap_mat <- fastshap::explain(model, X = trainX_sel, newdata = val_X_sel,
                                  pred_wrapper = pred_wrapper, nsim = SHAP_NSIM)
    shap_df <- as.data.frame(shap_mat)
    shap_df$SampleID <- rownames(val_X_sel)

    actual_pred   <- pred_wrapper(model, val_X_sel)
    reconstructed <- baseline + rowSums(shap_df %>% dplyr::select(-SampleID))
    max_diff <- max(abs(reconstructed - actual_pred))
    cat(sprintf("[SHAP check] %s / %s: max|reconstructed-actual| = %.4f across %d samples (nsim=%d)\n",
               kingdom, cohort, max_diff, nrow(shap_df), SHAP_NSIM))
    if (max_diff > 0.05)
      warning(sprintf("[SHAP check] %s/%s: reconstruction error %.3f exceeds 0.05 -- consider raising SHAP_NSIM.",
                      kingdom, cohort, max_diff))

    abund_long <- val_X_sel %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
      tidyr::pivot_longer(-SampleID, names_to = "Feature", values_to = "Abundance") %>%
      dplyr::group_by(Feature) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(Abundance_scaled = if (diff(range(Abundance)) > 0)
                      (Abundance - min(Abundance)) / (max(Abundance) - min(Abundance)) else 0.5) %>%
      dplyr::ungroup()

    shap_long <- shap_df %>%
      tidyr::pivot_longer(-SampleID, names_to = "Feature", values_to = "SHAP") %>%
      dplyr::mutate(Dataset = kingdom, Cohort = cohort) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(abund_long, by = c("SampleID", "Feature"))

    out[[cohort]] <- shap_long
  }
  list(baseline = baseline, shap_long = do.call(rbind, out))
}

shap_results <- list()
for (kname in names(kingdoms)) {
  ckpt_name <- sprintf("%s_shap_n20", kname)
  shap_results[[kname]] <- run_or_load(ckpt_name, function() {
    compute_shap_for_kingdom(kname, refit_models[[kname]], validation_lists[[kname]])
  })
}

shap_raw_long <- do.call(rbind, lapply(shap_results, `[[`, "shap_long"))

species_labels_all <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(consensus_features_list), function(k)
  build_species_labels(k, consensus_features_list[[k]])))

shap_raw_long <- shap_raw_long %>% dplyr::left_join(species_labels_all, by = c("Dataset", "Feature"))
```

```{r shap_beeswarm}
plot_shap_beeswarm <- function(kingdom, shap_df, kingdom_label) {
  cohort_levels <- c("China_Cohort", "Thai_Cohort", "Korea_Cohort")
  plot_df <- shap_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(Dataset == kingdom) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Cohort = factor(Cohort, levels = cohort_levels,
                                  labels = c("China Cohort", "Thai Cohort", "Korea Cohort")))

  feature_order <- plot_df %>% dplyr::group_by(Species_clean) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(mean_abs = mean(abs(SHAP)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(mean_abs) %>% dplyr::pull(Species_clean)
  plot_df$Species_clean <- factor(plot_df$Species_clean, levels = feature_order)

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = SHAP, y = Species_clean, color = Abundance_scaled)) +
    ggbeeswarm::geom_quasirandom(groupOnX = FALSE, size = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    scale_color_gradient(low = "#1e7eeb", high = "#d93827", breaks = c(0, 1), 
                         labels = c("Low", "High"), name = "Feature\nvalue") +
    facet_wrap(~ Cohort) +
    labs(title = sprintf("SHAP summary -- %s", kingdom_label),
        #subtitle = "Final model refit on full discovery data; explained on each external cohort",
        x = "SHAP value (impact on predicted P(HCC))", y = NULL) +
    theme_report +
    theme(legend.position = "right", 
          legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
          legend.text = element_text(size=9),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11))
}
```

```{r refit_performance}
refit_performance <- list()
for (kname in names(kingdoms)) {
  refit <- refit_models[[kname]]
  val_list <- validation_lists[[kname]]
  for (cohort in names(val_list)) {
    val_data <- val_list[[cohort]]
    val_X_sel <- val_data$X[, colnames(refit$trainX_sel), drop = FALSE]
    probs <- pred_wrapper(refit$model, val_X_sel)
    preds <- predict(refit$model, newdata = val_X_sel)
    cm <- confusionMatrix(preds, val_data$y, positive = "HCC")
    roc_val <- roc(val_data$y, probs, quiet = TRUE, levels = rev(c("HCC", "CO")), direction = "<")
    refit_performance[[length(refit_performance) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      Dataset = kname, Cohort = cohort, AUC = as.numeric(roc_val$auc),
      Acc = cm$overall[["Accuracy"]], Sens = cm$byClass[["Sensitivity"]], Spec = cm$byClass[["Specificity"]]
    )
  }
}
refit_performance <- do.call(rbind, refit_performance)

print(as.data.frame(refit_performance))
```
